extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and agents filing PCT national phase entries before the EPO (European procedure)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and required content for the designation of inventors when entering the European (EP) national phase under the PCT, including required statements where the applicant is not the inventor (assignment, employment, succession, contract).

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation must contain inventor name(s) and place(s) of residence
rubrics_metrics.description: The designation shall contain the name(s) and place(s) of residence of the inventor(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim text: "and place(s) of residence of the inventor(s)". The guide requires that the inventor(s) be identified by name and that their place(s) of residence be given; this is a mandatory element of the inventor designation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place of residence definition and postal code requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The place of residence is the city or other municipality where the inventor permanently resides, and includes the postal code (where applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim text: "The place of residence is the city or other municipality where the inventor permanently resides, and includes the postal code (where ... )". Use the inventor's permanent municipality and include postal code when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of origin of right when applicant is not (sole) inventor
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant is not the inventor or is not the sole inventor, the designation shall contain a statement indicating the origin of the right to (the patent).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim text: "If the applicant is not the inventor or is not the sole inventor, the designation shall contain a statement indicating the origin of the right to". The French equivalent is also provided in the guide. Examples of origins given elsewhere in the text include assignment, succession (heir), employment, or rights arising under a contract.

rubrics_metrics.name: In case of assignment include explicit wording indicating assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: When the applicant's right derives from an assignment, the designation must indicate that fact by using wording showing the assignment/origin of rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim fragment: "In the case of assignment the words ..." (text truncated). Guidance implies the designation should include explicit wording that the right has been acquired by assignment and identify the assigning party (where applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: In case of employee invention indicate employee relationship
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the invention was made by an employee, the designation must mention that the inventor(s) is/are employee(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim text: "In the case of inventions by employees a mention that the inventor(s) is/are employee(s)". Include a clear statement that the inventor(s) were employees (and, if relevant, of which employer) to explain the origin of the applicant's right.

rubrics_metrics.name: In case of succession indicate that applicant(s) are heirs
rubrics_metrics.description: Where rights have passed by succession, the designation must state that the applicant(s) is/are heir(s) of the inventor(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim text: "In the case of succession a mention that the applicant(s) is/are heir(s) of the inventor(s) is" (text truncated). The designation should explicitly identify that the applicant acquired rights as heir(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Where rights derive from contract, state 'en vertu du contrat' (or equivalent)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant's right arises under a contractual arrangement, the designation should indicate that the right was acquired 'en vertu du contrat' (under the contract) or use equivalent wording.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: French fragment: "mentionner « en vertu du contrat ...". The guide signals that contractual origin of rights must be explicitly stated in the designation using appropriate wording.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor designation concerns natural persons (and treatment of legal persons referenced)
rubrics_metrics.description: The guide distinguishes natural persons (les personnes physiques) in inventor designation and separately refers to legal persons and companies assimilated to legal persons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: French fragments: "Les personnes physiques doivent être dési-..." and "Les personnes morales et les sociétés assimilées aux personnes morales...". This indicates the formal treatment/identification differs for natural persons versus legal entities; inventors are natural persons and other corporate/assimilated entities are addressed separately when indicating applicant status or rights.
